en: This time of day... nobody should be around, yeah?

zh: 可千万别有人……总算溜上来了
en: Please let no one be here... finally snuck up.

zh: <color=#FF0000>逃课上来要是被抓，那可就不是写检讨那么简单了</color>
en: <color=#FF0000>If I get busted for ditching up here, it’s way more than writing a reflection.</color>

zh: 学校纪律处的那帮人，一张处分单下来，这学期直接就完蛋了
en: One ticket from Discipline and my semester’s done.

zh: 刚才在五楼楼梯口，差点跟教务主任对脸撞上
en: I nearly ran face-first into the dean at the fifth-floor stairwell just now.

zh: 他正盯着文件往楼下走，我贴在冰凉的墙面上，呼吸都快停了
en: He was fixed on his documents as he descended; I pressed to the frigid wall, breath all but stilled.

zh: 幸好他突然拐进办公室了……吓死我了
en: Thankfully, he veered into his office... I was terrified.

zh: 终于到学校天台了！反正这节课我是不会回去了
en: Finally made it to the rooftop! I’m not going back to class this period anyway.
